description: Defines the class 'pusch_processor_metrics_aggregator' which collects and reports various performance metrics related to PUSCH processing in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: pusch_processor_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: A class that aggregates and provides metrics related to PUSCH processing, including latency, throughput, and channel estimation metrics.

methods.name: get_avg_data_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the average data processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_min_data_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the minimum data processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_max_data_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the maximum data latency in microseconds along with the slot point where it was detected.

methods.name: get_min_uci_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the minimum UCI processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_max_uci_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the maximum UCI processing latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_avg_uci_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the average UCI latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_processing_rate_Mbps
methods.description: Calculates and returns the PUSCH processing transmission rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_total_time
methods.description: Returns the total processing time as a duration.

methods.name: get_total_wait_time
methods.description: Returns the total wait time for asynchronous decoding.

methods.name: get_cpu_usage_us
methods.description: Returns the CPU usage in microseconds for scrambling operations.

methods.name: get_ch_est_sinr
methods.description: Returns the SINR in decibels from channel estimation.

methods.name: get_ch_est_evm
methods.description: Returns the EVM from channel estimation.

methods.name: get_decoding_bler
methods.description: Returns the decoding block error rate.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all internal counters and metrics to initial state.
